notes.title: v1.3.3 Bugfixes and improvements
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fix typo in Jasper laptop email.
[*] Set subtitles to on by default.
[*] Improved the performance of the magnifying glass lens shader.
[*] Fix potential uninitialized texture bug in videos.
[*] Fixed a top floor view where control room door would appear closed when it should be open.
[*] Fixed a top floor view where the key should not appear in the door.
[*] Added a couple of extra hints in reception emails.
[*] Added camera hint on MCI level safe.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.3.2 Bugfix release
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fix for some computer applications not scaling correctly on high DPI screens or above HD resolution.
[*] Fix for infinite loop when switching to unsupported resolutions.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix for v1.3.0
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug when in a closeup view, the game could crash after returning to focus and restoring fullscreen.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.3.0 'Easter Egg' update
notes.notes:
[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in computers where username/password was persisting from machine to machine.
[*] Fixed a typo in the lockdown email.
[*] Fixed a typo in the "Paid leave" email.
[*] Fixed a missing dead drill subtitle.
[*] Fixed a bug where mouse coordinates on finale screen were wrong at certain resolutions.
[/list]

[h2]Puzzles[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added an extra email to Cheryl's laptop.
[*] Added extra clues for milliAV / MCI.
[*] You can now drag the plank without having to click on the hole in MCI.
[*] The gondola lever region has been made bigger.
[*] Miguel's postcard now says 'LOCKER PART#' to be less ambiguous. 
[/list]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Allow the middle mouse button to toggle the inventory
[*] The music in the lifts now alternates between two tracks.
[*] Easter eggs !
[/list]

notes.title: v1.2.1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixes a subtitle timing bug where subtitles sometimes wouldn't appear. 
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for v1.2 (Feb 2025) - Subtitles and many other fixes !
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] We've added English subtitles to all speech, and a few other sound effects.
[*] If enabled, subtitles can also help with the music puzzle.
[*] Fixed an issue involving ultrawide screens and large aspect ratio monitors.
[*] Fixed an issue with window mode defaults on startup and window border.
[*] Fixed a couple of rare graphical glitches in the lobby.
[*] Fixed an issue where a paused sound could play over the menu if restarted.
[*] Fixed mouse event issues.
[*] Fixed a bug in the final puzzle which allowed an early finish in some circumstances.
[*] Increased the range of camera speeds in settings.
[*] Fixed some camera issues when getting the magnifying glass out or clicking off the inventory.
[/list]
